configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: cd backend && CTEM_COOKIE_SECURE=false CTEM_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS=true CTEM_LOG_JSON=false CTEM_REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:63799/0 uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

configurations.name: worker
runtimeArgs: cd backend && CTEM_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS=true CTEM_LOG_JSON=false CTEM_WORKER_METRICS_PORT=9108 uv run python -m app.workers.runner
